REAL outbound-drop (Daniel-caught, watchdog missed). Wedged session 72c50a7c received Daniel's Telegram msgs as proper user turns and generated a text reply to each (2:37pm "Yep, I'm here / Quick status...", 3:01pm "cleared the draft") but NONE were delivered to Telegram - the plugin's outbound text auto-relay had silently died. Daniel got total silence; first delivered reply was 3:52pm from the NEW post-restart session (different text, "Yep, I'm here. What's up?", to re-sent msg #2437). NOT a ghost-text input wedge (C) - inbound turns submitted fine; ghost-text incidental. Watchdog SAW it (no_reply_streak->DEGRADED) but per canary v2 (6/16) treats text-without-send-call as neutral/no-restart, so it neither recovered nor logged - the 6/16 false-POSITIVE fix created a false-NEGATIVE on real relay-death. Also: the daisy-imessage send that started the turn HUNG ~13 min (2:55-3:08pm) on AppleEvent timeout -1712 before failing (unbounded send timeout). Transcript-confirmed + Codex-reviewed.
column5: Manual front-door restart (com.daisy.restart) at 3:06pm restored delivery; confirmed by delivered reply to msg #2437 at 3:52pm. FOLLOW-UPS: (1) canary needs a real Telegram delivery check (not transcript inference) to catch relay-death without re-introducing the 6/15-6/16 false-positive restart loop; (2) bound the daisy-imessage AppleScript send timeout so a failing send fails fast instead of freezing a turn 13 min.

column4: CORRECTION + FIX to today's earlier cause-D entry. Deeper investigation reframes the root cause: NOT relay-death and NOT 'reply tool unregistered at boot' (that exact error — No such tool available: ...reply — has occurred exactly ONCE in all transcript history, 05-30, never in the 6/18 or 6/21 windows it was blamed on). Real root cause = REPLY-TOOL ADHERENCE DRIFT: inbound arrives correctly framed (<channel source=plugin:telegram:telegram chat_id=5635145480 ...>), the reply tool works when called, but on conversational turns she answers in PANE TEXT and never calls mcp__plugin_telegram_telegram__reply, so nothing reaches Daniel. Only messages carrying an explicit 'use the reply tool' instruction (scheduled rundown, healthcheck probe) get through — which is why the boot healthcheck passes green while real replies silently die (it FORCES the one tool call real convo skips). Plugin reply instruction is byte-identical pre/post the 6/23 03:07 plugin update (update only touched reaction code); drift happened on both pre- and post-update sessions, so the update is NOT the trigger. Likely historical incidents (6/18, 6/21 x2) were this same drift, mislabeled. Codex concurred across the whole chain.
column5: 3-layer fix shipped today (Codex-reviewed): (1) STOPGAP — injected a standing reply-tool instruction into the live session; she now delivers (Daniel confirmed receipt). (2) DURABLE — added a top-of-file 'Telegram Reply Contract (NON-NEGOTIABLE)' to ~/daisy/CLAUDE.md (backup in patches/); loads on next restart. (3) ENFORCEMENT — new com.daisy.replyguard LaunchAgent (60s) runs guard_reply.py (detects: latest <channel> inbound + substantive pane answer + NO reply call => NEEDS_NUDGE) -> guard_reply.sh debounces 2 ticks, nudges her via lib_send_prompt to resend via the reply tool, escalates ONCE via static send_telegram if the nudge doesn't take. Tested on the frozen photography-drift transcript (NEEDS_NUDGE mid=2565) + dry-run state machine (arm->nudge->escalate->standdown). OPEN FOLLOW-UPS: add an UNFORCED-inbound probe to post_restart_healthcheck.sh (forced probe can't see this class); per-incident re-adjudication of past 'cause D' entries; feature-log entry.

Common boot confirms in ~2s (faster than old 20s) yet tolerates a slow boot to 40s. Downstream reply-tool healthcheck unaffected (owns its own 60s busy-wait + 75s delivery poll). Test-fired live: poller confirmed in 2s, reply tool DELIVERED attempt 1, doctor HEALTHY, single poller; Daniel confirmed a real Telegram round-trip. Daily false 3:00 restart alert since 7/15: all 3 boot attempts fail on poller-not-confirmed, 🚨 FAILED alert fires at ~03:02, watchdog silently recovers at ~03:09 (poller alive in 2s). Six mornings running. Investigation (read-only) established: no new Claude session transcript is created during the 3:00 window (7/19+7/20), poller genuinely absent per watchdog at 03:04 and 03:09, and the identical script/job succeeds 9 min later. RULED OUT: sleep/dark-wake (sleep 0 on AC), plugin version drift (still telegram/0.0.6, pkill patterns match), silent CC update (2.1.207 = pinned baseline), slow shell (zsh -i 0.01s), 2:50 handoff overrunning (done by 02:50:45), and timeout-too-short (the 7/15 fix treated the wrong layer - poller is not slow, it never starts). ROOT CAUSE STILL OPEN. Codex refused review (Daisy rails), so: careful self-review + live test-fires.
column5: Shipped the same session: (1) instrumented launch - claude now starts via bin/daisy_boot_launch.sh which logs start/pid/exit-code to logs/claude_boot.log, tmux new-session+send-keys are status-checked, an early 4s check asks whether claude actually appeared, and any boot failure dumps forensics (pane capture, recursive pane-descendant process tree, explicit claude/poller present-or-absent, channel dir listing) to logs/boot_fail_*.txt, pruned to 40. This distinguishes the three states the old code could not: never-launched vs launched-and-died vs running-but-no-poller. (2) Alerting fixed: the 3-boot failure now branches on FAIL_MODE - a real reply-tool failure still pages immediately, but poller-never-confirmed writes state/boot_failed and stays SILENT, handing recovery AND escalation to the watchdog (single owner; both call kill-server/pkill/rm-pidfile so overlapping them would race). Watchdog recovers quietly when the crumb is fresh (<20min), logs the incident either way, and pages loudly if recovery fails. Self-review caught 3 bugs pre-ship: rc=$? inside if-not-cmd reports the negation, ps -g missed the claude grandchild in the process tree, and unbounded forensics growth. Backups: patches/restart_daisy.sh.bak-20260720, patches/watchdog.sh.bak-20260720. Verified by 2 live front-door restarts (clean boot attempt 1, reply tool DELIVERED, no spurious forensics/crumb) plus standalone exercise of the forensics + crumb-freshness paths.
